verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms a maintained llms.txt at the site root that is explicitly written for AI assistants. A second probe shows the docs are served as raw .md pages, each of which points agents to a complete documentation index at /docs/llms.txt. The many .md doc URLs in the pack corroborate agent-friendly markdown docs. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or bundled full-docs export, and independent community confirmation of agents using these files in practice.
